svg.title: TagTeam — practice Japanese office calls with a live avatar coach
svg.desc: TagTeam lets non-native residents practice real Japanese bureaucracy phone calls with an avatar. The right panel shows the in-call co-pilot: the receptionist's line, live vocabulary cards, and hold-help.

g.text: AI CALL COACH · JAPANESE OFFICE CALLS
